delta.mechanism: Change only the descriptive text and the accepted ACTIVE 1-of-2 Redundancy.TSWOV value from zero to one hour. Preserve all parent topology, failure/repair/stock data, missions, seed, repetitions, and horizon.

predeclared_native_acceptance: The two changed fields roundtrip exactly, all 22 author-populated tables remain intact, converter errors are zero, and the only converter warnings are reviewed Control #108 and Redundancy #282 stating TSWOV ignored; native event/report artifacts are nonempty and valid.

Both runs retain two isolated noncritical LRU failures, three successful missions, the same LRU/SRU stock and repair ledger, 72 aligned report bins and ready terminal aircraft.

limits: This probes one positive ACTIVE TSWOV value in one 1-of-2 single-item topology, fixed seed and 36-hour horizon. Passive switching and other values/topologies are unverified.
